title: Advantech WebAccess/NMS MibbrowserTrapAddAction XML External Entity Reference Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Advantech WebAccess/NMS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of calls to the MibbrowserMibbrowserTrapAddAction method.
